0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The unfulfilled forager has a craving for meat.

24.original: Use the wrangling rope on a weakened tragopan.

25.original: Deliver the trussed-up tragopan to the unfulfilled forager.

48.original: Ah, what I wouldn't give for just one mouthful of juicy meat...

49.original: I've eaten naught but meol for more moons than I can count! I mean, I'm grateful for the handouts and all but sometimes a man needs variety.

50.original: Aye, if I had me a roasted game bird about now, I'd strip that beauty down to the bone!

51.original: But have you ever tried catchin' one of them tragopans? It's like askin' to have your eyes pecked out. ...What, you reckon you could do better?

52.original: Go ahead, then─make me eat my own words. Just so long as they come with a side dish of bird flesh!

53.original: And make sure you bring it back alive and kickin', you understand? Here's a rope to truss it up, and a sack to carry it. You might need to, uh, daze it a bit first...

54.original: Once you've knocked the fight out of the bird, you can bind it with that length of rope!

55.original: Tell me there's a bird in that sack!

56.original: Oof, that's a feisty one! Nice work, stranger!

57.original: Ah, seein' this fellow all trussed up for the dinner table reminds me of bein' back in Stilltide...

58.original: It's been years since I left to chase after Eulmore's promises, but I'm no closer to gettin' through that gate than when I started.

59.original: It's been years since I left to chase after Eulmore's promises─I suppose I've just gotten too used to the life here in Gatetown.

60.original: Maybe it's time I gave up on hollow dreams and went home to my old mum...<hex:02100103>Anyway, my thanks for the bird, friend!
